messages:
alex: Customer reported a hard failure when using JSON mode for nested invoices. Parser throws on an extra key in array items and their downstream billing ETL aborted. Ticket #INC-4821.

maria: Can you paste the original request + response (sanitized)? Also need the request_id and model.

alex: Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Model: redwood-xlm-2. Here's the sanitized payload and the API response we got: 

alex: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \u002dH 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \u002dH 'Content-Type: application/json' \u002dd '{"mode":"json","schema":{"invoice":{"lines":[{"charge_id":"c_123","amount":100},{"amount":50,"meta":{"note":"one-off"}}]}}}'
```

alex: Response: ```json
{"error":"Invalid JSON mode output: item 2 in invoice.lines missing required key 'charge_id' and contains unexpected key 'meta'","trace_id":"req_0a1b2c3d"}
```

sam: Oof. Downstream consumer assumes ordering and presence of 'charge_id'. Looks like model output produced a partial object for the second line and added an extra 'meta' key.

eng-oncall: Can you repro locally with the same prompt/seed? Also paste the exact prompt template or the eval harness. If we can reproduce we should add a postprocess patch that enforces required keys and logs a soft-fail instead of returning invalid array.

alex: Repro steps: 1) use JSON mode + schema above 2) set max_tokens=150 3) send the following prompt header: "Generate invoice JSON lines for order #889" 4) repeat 20x -> error appears ~35% of the time.

maria: Do we see any billing implications? Is the customer being charged incorrectly?

billing-bot: Not seeing duplicate charges on our side for req_0a1b2c3d. Billing pipeline failed when trying to enrich lines with charge metadata, so invoice generation stalled for customer workflow. No extra billing events recorded.

eng-oncall: Temporary mitigations: (a) server-side sanitizer: drop unknown keys and fill missing 'charge_id' with "unknown_charge" and mark with warning meta (b) add a strict-mode flag that rejects but returns structured error explaining which items failed (c) enable model variant fallback to a higher-precision generator.

sam: Also add a quick client-side patch for the customer: ignore ordering assumptions and validate items exist by key, not position. Share a minimal JS snippet to robustly parse arrays.

alex: Sent customer the JS patch and asked for logs. They're running in prod so latency spikes of 5-10s reported when JSON mode fails and we do retries. Root cause seems to be schema drift in model outputs (sometimes omits required fields, sometimes emits extra debugging keys).

maria: Can eng put a short-term rollout: sanitizer + error telemetry so we can measure frequency and impact? If it remains >1% for a major account, escalate to model team for prompt/temperature tuning.

eng-oncall: Will roll sanitizer to canary tomorrow in us-west-2 and add metrics: invalid_jsonmode_count, invalid_items_per_response. Will also attach sample failing outputs to the ticket (sanitized).

alex: Thanks — customer wants ETA. Can we tell them ~48h for canary + config to turn on strict-mode for them?

eng-oncall: Yes, 48h estimate. I'll follow up with the rollout PR link.

maria: Marking INC-4821 for tracking. If billing pipeline replays happen, ping billing and we will coordinate reruns. :thumbsup:
